# AUB Handoff Analysis

## Status: CRITICAL - Fully Degenerate Baseline

| Metric | Value | Assessment |
|--------|-------|------------|
| Exposure | 0.0 / 0.0 | ❌ No positions taken |
| Degenerate Folds | 19/19 | ❌ 100% failure |
| Champion File | (empty) | ❌ No valid model |

The unified baseline has collapsed to a no-trade state. All folds degenerate indicates systemic issue—likely threshold miscalibration or feature pipeline failure producing NaN/constant outputs.

## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
python -m src.aub.diagnose --lane ost_v62_unified --check-features --check-thresholds
python -m src.aub.run --lane ost_v62_unified --force-rebuild --threshold-scan 0.001,0.01,0.05
python -m src.aub.status --lane ost_v62_unified --verbose
```

## Rationale

1. **diagnose**: Inspect feature distributions and threshold settings that caused zero signal generation
2. **run --force-rebuild --threshold-scan**: Rebuild from scratch with relaxed position thresholds to recover trading activity
3. **status --verbose**: Verify recovery and new fold health

If threshold scan fails to recover exposure, escalate to feature pipeline audit.
